title: Gambit Godot client component diagram
description: The Godot 4 project (GDScript, Compatibility renderer for WebGL 2). Its one scene runs main.gd; api.gd and sfx.gd are autoloads. The rules live apart from the scripts, and the web export runs in web_shell/shell.html, which loads the page bridge.

components.name: Scripts
components.responsibility: The shell and its screens, a game beside the 3D table, the pieces, the look, sounds, and the API, live connection and page bridge client.

components.name: Chess rules
components.responsibility: Positions, legal moves, SAN, check, mate and draws in GDScript, for the board in the game.

components.name: Web shell (shell.html)
components.responsibility: The page the web export runs in: the canvas, the loading screen and the bridge.js script.

components.name: Chess Worker
components.responsibility: Sign-in, the JSON API and live games.

relationships.description: The scene's script and the autoloads.
Chess.Game for the game shown, Chess.Position for the board, legal moves for picking pieces.
HTTPRequest to api/ and auth/, WebSocketPeer to api/games/{id}/live.
Loads bridge.js, which starts the engine.
